# Jan Katewicz, Elementa Laudis

> I make contemporary marquetry in my studio in Sheffield. I cut and assemble every element by hand from natural veneer and then dye it myself. It is a craft that has almost disappeared in Britain and in the world, and only a handful of people still work it at this scale.

Contemporary marquetry artist based in Sheffield, United Kingdom. Works are unique
panels of hand cut wood veneer, dyed by the artist, at wall scale rather than the
furniture scale marquetry is normally made at. Marquetry is on the Heritage Crafts
Red List of Endangered Crafts. Work is sold directly from this site and through
exhibitions and fairs, and is held in private collections in five countries.
Works are grouped in three series: Innerysm, Now, and Now feat Addiction.
Member of Joined Up Heritage Sheffield (JUHS). The site is published in English at https://elementalaudis.com/ and in Polish at https://elementalaudis.com/pl/.
